http/http2_session#

The client side of one HTTP/2 connection: many requests at once on one socket, after the preface and settings.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The client side of one HTTP/2 connection: many requests at once on one socket, after the preface and settings.

Public API#

object Http2Session#

object Http2Session does Closing

Adopts an already selected H2 transport AFTER client preface. Pool/ALPN and external deadlines belong to opening/client decorators, never guessed here.
